title: 街のトレンドメーカー♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I have something I want to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I have something I want to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, some of the younger students invited me to go out with them.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They want to go shopping in a fashionable area. And they're interested in all the latest styles, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But there's something I'm a little bit worried about…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trends change so fast these days.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm trying my best to learn, but when I talk to people…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I sometimes wonder whether people get what I'm saying. I'm sure that sort of thing happens to you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I sometimes wonder whether people get what I'm saying. I'm sure that sort of thing happens to you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It'd make things awkward if I said the wrong thing while we're all hanging out, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I don't want to let everyone down, so please give me some good ideas of what to do!
choice_data_list: Let's touch up your sense of style.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay. So you and I are going to check out the latest trends together?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay. So you and I are going to check out the latest trends together?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and I arrive at a very fashionable shopping area.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, let's check out the latest trends!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, let's check out the latest trends!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, there's a CD store over there. I wonder if we can listen to some of the latest tunes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky points to a used record shop.
choice_data_list: I don't think you'll find the most trendy music there…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Hmm… I guess that particular place doesn't deal in the latest music, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oooh, what about that boutique over there! I'm sensing a stylish aura coming from it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky points to what appears to be a vintage clothing store.
choice_data_list: I don't think they'll have the latest fashions at that place…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Well then, on to the next one…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… It's hard to figure out what the latest trends are. I just can't seem to wrap my head around it…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My mom told me it's good to stay on top of this sort of thing, but it's hard…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my mom is so cheerful and bright. She's super fun to be around!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: She's also very fashionable. I've admired that about her since I was a kid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky lights up when she talks about her mother.
choice_data_list: What about telling the younger students what your mother taught you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah… That might just work.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I could teach them the latest trends that I learned from my mother.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And rather than blindly chase other people's trends, we could share our own ideas and make things more fun! Okay, I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yesterday, I went out with the younger students, and we had a great time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I was able to recommend some hip places. Everyone had a totally fresh experience! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We all agreed to go out again soon. Hehe! I wonder where we should go next! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky's smile tells me that she made some good memories with the younger students.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You mean I should be more confident in what I like?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Maybe I am obsessing over this stuff a little too much…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's not like me to feel so insecure.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I have to believe in myself! I'm always at the forefront of what's hip!
choice_data_list: I think everyone already realizes that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right. I bet everyone knows about my sense of style!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm the trendiest Umamusume of them all! As the youth say, I'm the bomb dot com!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That really got me pumped up! This next outing with the girls will be off the hook! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, I ask Maruzensky how her time with the younger students went.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heehee! I was right to take your advice. I got to know everyone even better!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We went shopping, had dinner, and went to karaoke together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I sang a lot of the hit songs that my mom taught me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They said they had a lot of fun listening to songs they'd never heard before.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I also learned a lot of new trendy stuff from them. It was a good experience!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm even trendier, everyone's going to want to watch me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Charming, with a unique sense of style… That's Maruzensky in a nutshell.
